368.title: Add a `log` command for the Audit Log page
368.body: The Audit Log page needs a command line view of `AuditStore.list`.

370.title: History and log print a missing old value as `None`
370.body: `python3 -m ledger history` shows the create entry as `None -> Jansen BV`.

comments.author: owner
comments.body:
> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Agent Brief

**Category:** bug
**Summary:** Print an empty old value as `(empty)`

**Current behavior:** `show` in `ledger/__main__.py` formats `old_value` with an f-string, so a create row prints `None -> Jansen BV`.

**Desired behavior:** A missing old or new value prints as `(empty)`.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] A test runs `show` on a create row and finds `(empty) -> Jansen BV`.

**Out of scope:** anything else in `ledger/`.

371.title: History: a --since option
371.body: Show only the history entries changed on or after a given date.

comments.author: owner
comments.body:
> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Agent Brief

**Category:** enhancement
**Summary:** `history --since <date>`

**Current behavior:** `history` prints an entity's whole history.

**Desired behavior:** `history --since 2026-10-02` prints only entries with `changed_at` on or after that date.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] A test seeds Customer 7 and finds only the 2026-10-02 edit with `--since 2026-10-02`.

**Out of scope:** the other commands.

372.title: Index audit_logs on entity and changed_at

comments.author: owner
comments.body:
> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Agent Brief

**Category:** enhancement
**Summary:** An index for `list_by_entity`

**Current behavior:** `AuditStore.__init__` creates `audit_logs` with no index, so `list_by_entity` scans every row.

**Desired behavior:** `AuditStore.__init__` creates an index on `(entity_type, entity_id, changed_at)` if it does not exist.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] A test finds the index in `sqlite_master` after `AuditStore` opens a fresh database.

**Out of scope:** the other commands.

373.title: `log` takes no --limit
373.body: The Audit Log page shows 50 rows; `log` has no way to ask for more or fewer.

comments.author: owner
comments.body:
> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Agent Brief

**Category:** enhancement
**Summary:** `log --limit <n>`

**Current behavior:** `log` always calls `AuditStore.list()` with its default limit of 50.

**Desired behavior:** `log --limit <n>` passes `n` to `AuditStore.list`.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] A test seeds the database and finds two rows with `log --limit 2`.

**Out of scope:** the other commands.
